newsitem.title: UK: UK's ITC names NatWest Markets as adviser.
newsitem.headline: UK's ITC names NatWest Markets as adviser.

text.p: Britain's commercial television watchdog the Independent Television Commission (ITC) said it has appointed NatWest Markets, the investment banking arm of National Westminster Bank Plc, to advise it.
The ITC said NatWest Markets would assist on the financial aspects of the award of digital terrestrial multiplex licences and the licence for the additional service on Channel 5.
NatWest Markets has agreed not to act as a financial adviser to any licence applicant while it is advising the ITC. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717.
